cells.name: E. coli
cells.note: Facultative heterotroph. Ferments to acetate, formate and ethanol when O2 runs short.

reactions.name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: coa_c + nad_c + pyr_c --> accoa_c + co2_c + nadh_c

reactions.name: Citrate synthase
reactions.equation: accoa_c + h2o_c + oaa_c --> cit_c + coa_c + h_c

reactions.name: 2-Oxoglutarate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: akg_c + coa_c + nad_c --> co2_c + nadh_c + succoa_c

reactions.name: Succinyl-CoA synthetase
reactions.equation: atp_c + coa_c + succ_c <=> adp_c + pi_c + succoa_c

reactions.name: Phosphoenolpyruvate carboxylase
reactions.equation: co2_c + h2o_c + pep_c --> h_c + oaa_c + pi_c

reactions.name: PEP synthase (gluconeogenesis from pyruvate)
reactions.equation: atp_c + h2o_c + pyr_c --> amp_c + 2 h_c + pep_c + pi_c

reactions.name: Malate synthase
reactions.equation: accoa_c + glx_c + h2o_c --> coa_c + h_c + mal__L_c

reactions.name: Acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (acetylating)
reactions.equation: acald_c + coa_c + nad_c <=> accoa_c + h_c + nadh_c

reactions.name: Glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP)
reactions.equation: glu__L_c + h2o_c + nadp_c <=> akg_c + h_c + nadph_c + nh4_c

reactions.name: Glutamine synthetase
reactions.equation: atp_c + glu__L_c + nh4_c --> adp_c + gln__L_c + h_c + pi_c

reactions.name: ATP synthase (proton-motive force)
reactions.equation: adp_c + 4 h_p + pi_c <=> atp_c + h2o_c + 3 h_c

reactions.name: NADH dehydrogenase (pumps H+ into the periplasm)
reactions.equation: 4 h_c + nadh_c + q8_c --> 3 h_p + nad_c + q8h2_c

reactions.name: Membrane transhydrogenase
reactions.equation: 2 h_p + nadh_c + nadp_c --> 2 h_c + nad_c + nadph_c
